cadence: daily administrative review at 06:15 while any Tang Wei Qin command petition or House Tang routing inquiry remains unresolved
constraints: no Qin appointment, rank, vacancy, commander location, private-unit acceptance, or deployment without a lawful authority and current supporting state
no staff decision or information delivery without a valid receiving staff, clerk, courier, or House Tang information path
a petition may remain pending when no live vacancy or receiving command need exists
goals: resolve Ouki staff review when supported
resolve Mou Bu staff review when supported
route Tang Wei's Duke Hyou-addressed petition when a lawful receiving channel exists
trace the Qin authority responsible for Duke Hyou mobilization or officer assignment through Tang Ling's inquiry
reconstruction_policy: Use the filed petitions, current command and appointment owners, receiving staff, clerk records, House Tang inquiry state, routes, exact elapsed time, and prior receipts. Never invent a vacancy, office, location, appointment, or response.
replanning_policy: At each review, check each unresolved path independently. Deliver a result only through a valid information path; keep unsupported paths pending and continue the daily review while any path remains open.
safe_compaction_policy: Daily reviews may be compacted only when each internal review is processed in order and no vacancy, command activation, response, route change, or information delivery occurs inside the span.
standing_orders: check Ouki and Mou Bu staff-review status against current command and vacancy state
maintain the Duke Hyou routing petition until a lawful receiving command or staff channel exists
continue Tang Ling's targeted mobilization-authority inquiry through valid House Tang contacts
deliver new results to Tang Wei only through a real report path
